name: Amanohashi Ikkaku
source:
Amanohashi is the school's chairman of the board of trustees who dreams of educating an ideal woman. He is wealthy and invites the students to the yearly Christmas party he holds at his residence. He's an old friend of fashion designer Goro Hanatsubaki. It is suggested that his father is an acquaintance of Hazuki's grandfather. He was instrumental in admitting Kijou into the school.

[From [url=http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Tokimeki_Memorial_Girl%27s_Side]Wikipedia[/url]]
